Turn each CLI-presence assertion into an absence assertion, generalizing the precedent ALREADY IN TREE at line 838 (TestTier2SpineAlreadyBoundForDispatchedCrews, which asserts absence for 2 files and pins the same human ruling). Keep the door-tool-named-affirmatively halves exactly as strict. Then regenerate tests/data/store_mentions.approved.txt. Only a correct pattern passes both. Revert the scratch edit.
